inherited_from: step 03 (the Merge) -- EIP-4399/EIP-3675. Graded at --state.fork=Merge inside the London inherited group so that dropping the Merge is still caught after step 03's verifier stops running.
name: prevrandao-zero-randao-still-executes
rationale: A zero randao is legal. Slot 0 is then absent either way, so the sentinel in slot 1 separates 'returned zero' from 'never ran'.
